description: Machine-readable ABI contract for jcs-canon CLI

canonicalize.description: Parse JSON, emit canonical RFC 8785 bytes to stdout.

--quiet.description: Accepted for command symmetry; canonicalize is silent on success.

--lines.description: Accepted for command symmetry; --lines is only meaningful for check-es6-corpus.

--help.description: Display command help to stdout and exit 0.

canonicalize.input: stdin (default or explicit '-') or file path

verify.description: Parse JSON, canonicalize, compare bytes to verify canonical form.

--lines.description: Accepted for command symmetry; --lines is only meaningful for check-es6-corpus.

--help.description: Display command help to stdout and exit 0.

verify.input: stdin (default or explicit '-') or file path
verify.stderr: 'ok\n' on success (unless --quiet), error diagnostics on failure

check-es6-corpus.description: Compute the official ES6 number corpus SHA-256 for the first N lines of the deterministic float corpus. Enables governance-layer black-box verification: the governance harness invokes this command and compares output against the governed checksum in governance.lock.json.

--quiet.description: Accepted for command symmetry; check-es6-corpus produces no success output to suppress.

--lines.description: Number of corpus lines to generate (1..100000000, default: 10000).

--help.description: Display command help to stdout and exit 0.

check-es6-corpus.input: none (flags only; corpus generated programmatically via --lines N)
check-es6-corpus.stdout: 64-hex lowercase SHA-256 digest followed by a newline
check-es6-corpus.stderr: lines=<N> on success, error diagnostics on failure

--help.description: Display global help to stdout and exit 0.

--version.description: Display version to stdout and exit 0.

2.description: Input rejected: parse error, profile violation, non-canonical form, or CLI usage error.

10.description: Internal I/O failure or unexpected error.

stream_policy.help_output: stdout (all --help invocations, both global and subcommand)

compatibility.policy: Strict SemVer. Any change to items marked 'stable: true' requires major version bump.
compatibility.stderr_wording: Non-stable. Diagnostic message text may change in minor/patch releases. Failure class names in stderr are stable.
compatibility.exit_code_mapping: Stable. Failure class → exit code mapping is frozen.
